english: I had to think of a way of preventing him from following me around all morning.
text: preventing him from following… 说明要阻止的是他一直跟着，而不是阻止他这个人存在。表达‘不让某事发生’，可以用 prevent someone from doing；think of a way 则先说自己得想出办法，并未透露已经成功摆脱。
